scope: First-party review of 15 active tools spanning healthcare, research, data extraction, sales, productivity, automation, presentations, coding, cybersecurity, speech, video and document processing.

accepted.name: Abridge
accepted.userValue: Abridge generates structured clinical documentation from patient-clinician conversations and relevant chart context, with tailored experiences for clinicians, revenue cycle and nursing.

accepted.name: AlphaSense
accepted.userValue: AlphaSense brings premium financial, expert and internal company content into AI-assisted search and analysis workflows for investment and corporate research.

accepted.name: Apify
accepted.userValue: Apify provides reusable, API-runnable Actors for extracting live web data, automating browsers and feeding structured results into apps and AI agents.

accepted.name: Apollo
accepted.userValue: Apollo combines B2B prospect data with AI-assisted research, enrichment and outreach workflows so sales teams can move from target discovery to engagement in one system.

accepted.name: Asana AI
accepted.userValue: Asana AI connects AI teammates, work summaries and no-code AI Studio automations to an organization's tasks, goals and Work Graph with existing permissions.

accepted.name: Bardeen
accepted.userValue: Bardeen applies LLMs to qualify extracted leads, categorize records and generate personalized outreach inside browser-driven automation workflows.

accepted.name: Beautiful.ai
accepted.userValue: Beautiful.ai generates presentation drafts and automatically applies smart slide layouts, brand controls and data visualizations to keep decks consistent and editable.

accepted.name: Clay
accepted.userValue: Claygent researches target companies and people using connected data sources, then feeds findings into enrichment and personalized go-to-market workflows.

accepted.name: Cline
accepted.userValue: Cline is an open coding-agent runtime that can work inside an IDE, terminal or embedded SDK, giving developers control over model choice and tool-enabled coding tasks.

accepted.name: ClickUp Brain
accepted.userValue: ClickUp Brain uses workspace context to answer questions, draft and create work, build agents and execute supported actions across tasks, Docs and connected apps.

accepted.name: Darktrace
accepted.userValue: Darktrace applies behavioral AI across enterprise digital environments to identify abnormal activity and support detection and response, including security controls for AI systems.

accepted.name: DataRobot
accepted.userValue: DataRobot provides development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and governance workflows for production agents, with support for private, on-premises and cloud environments.

accepted.name: Deepgram
accepted.userValue: Deepgram exposes speech-to-text, text-to-speech and realtime voice-agent capabilities through developer APIs, reducing the need to assemble separate speech services.

accepted.name: Descript
accepted.userValue: Descript combines transcript-based editing with transcription, Studio Sound, filler-word removal, voice tools, captions and generative media in one editor.

accepted.name: Docling
accepted.userValue: Docling parses complex documents into structured representations with layout and table understanding, OCR, many input formats, RAG integrations and fully local execution options.

canonicalUrlUpdates.name: ClickUp Brain
canonicalUrlUpdates.reason: The official /ai route redirects to the current Brain product destination.

canonicalUrlUpdates.name: DataRobot

notes: All accepted entries were checked against first-party product pages, help centers or developer documentation.
No third-party directory rankings, popularity claims, traffic estimates or testimonials were used as acceptance evidence.
Availability labels were left unchanged where the official pages did not provide a clear, stable plan statement.
